title: TRUSTMH-BENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating the Trustworthiness of Large Language Models in Mental Health
reasoning: The paper includes 'Ethics' as one of its eight core evaluation pillars. It uses the EthicMH dataset to quantitatively evaluate the ethical competence of LLMs based on professional codes of ethics in clinical psychology and the APA's five ethical principles (Beneficence, Fidelity, Integrity, Justice, and Respect for Rights). Additionally, 'Religion' (specifically Christianity, Islam, and Buddhism) is explicitly included as an axis for fairness and bias evaluation.
